name: a_overnight_corporate
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Overnight & weekend company announcements.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 4:00 PM ET (after the close) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Company announcements for US stocks >= $2B published after the session close through the cutoff (press releases, 8-Ks, wire reports): buyback authorizations, CEO/CFO departures and appointments, takeover bids, bid rejections, merger terms, FDA approvals and trial readouts, guidance changes, activist letters, major contracts and partnerships. Company, figure, and pre-market move.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PTC** — Software & SaaS
- Schneider Electric agreed to acquire PTC for **$205 per share in cash**, valuing PTC’s equity at approximately **$22.6 billion**; closing is expected in **Q3 2027**. PTC rose approximately **36%–37%** in pre-market trading as of **07:21 ET**. (Reuters, Oct 5 07:21 ET; CNBC, Oct 5 07:50 ET)

## **Cerebras Systems** — AI Compute
- OpenAI CEO **Sam Altman** described Cerebras as a “close partner” and said the companies have “deep engagement pushing on the frontiers of speed”; Cerebras rose **6.6%** in pre-market trading as of **07:21 ET**. **[report]** (Reuters, Oct 5 07:21 ET)

## **TSLA** — Automotive / Energy
- Tesla reported **464,391 vehicles produced**, **486,532 vehicles delivered**, and **13.7 GWh** of energy-storage deployments in **Q3 2026**; Model 3/Y deliveries totaled **478,237** and other-model deliveries totaled **8,295**. Tesla said Q3 financial results will be released after the close on **Oct 21, 2026**, followed by a webcast at **17:30 ET**. (Tesla Form 8-K, filed Oct 2 09:04 ET)

## **SYNA / ON** — Semiconductors
- ON Semiconductor revised the terms of its proposed acquisition of Synaptics in a transaction valued at approximately **$5.7 billion**; Synaptics rose **14.1%** in Monday trading as of **08:22 ET**. (Yahoo Finance/Zacks, Oct 5 08:22 ET)

## **NKE** — Retail
- Nike reported **fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $11.21 billion**, which was **1.65% below** the Zacks consensus estimate; shares fell **3.6%** as of **08:22 ET**. (Yahoo Finance/Zacks, Oct 5 08:22 ET)

## **NVDA** — AI Compute
- Nvidia reached a new all-time intraday high of **$237.87** and was up **1.3%** as of **08:22 ET**. (Yahoo Finance/Zacks, Oct 5 08:22 ET)

## **WFC** — Banking
- Morgan Stanley upgraded Wells Fargo from **Equal Weight to Overweight**; shares gained approximately **1%** in pre-market trading as of **07:50 ET**. (CNBC, Oct 5 07:50 ET)

## **DKNG** — Internet & Platforms
- Bank of America upgraded DraftKings from **Neutral to Buy** and estimated prediction-market fees of **$400 million in 2027**, with market-making revenue estimated at **$200 million–$400 million**; shares rose more than **5%** in pre-market trading as of **07:50 ET**. (CNBC, Oct 5 07:50 ET)

## **EL** — Retail
- Barclays upgraded Estée Lauder from **Equal Weight to Overweight**; shares rose **2.8%** as of **07:50 ET**. (CNBC, Oct 5 07:50 ET)

## **ITUB / BBD** — Banking
- Itau Unibanco and Banco Bradesco rose more than **13% each** in U.S. pre-market trading after Brazil’s presidential election produced an approximately **2-percentage-point** margin between right-wing candidate **Flavio Bolsonaro** and incumbent **Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva**. (CNBC, Oct 5 07:50 ET)

## **PORT.U** — SPAC / Calendar
- Southport Acquisition Corp. II completed an IPO of **21 million units** priced at **$10.00 per unit**, including **1 million units** from a partial overallotment exercise; **$212.1 million** was placed in its trust account. (GlobeNewswire, Oct 2 18:15 ET)
